The 1% rule is bidirectional — even if uncertain whether skill X applies, invoke it; if it turns out wrong, drop it.\\r\\n\\r\\n### Default skill catalog by domain (1556 SKILL.md across 21 active plugins + 14 marketplaces)\\r\\n\\r\\nWhen uncertain which skill applies, the meta-skill `using-agent-skills` auto-fires and surfaces relevant skills via description matching. ccbp-claude-mcp-full\\n## Configuration\\r\\n\\r\\nMCP servers are configured in `.mcp.json` at the project root (project-scoped) or in `~/.claude.json` (user-scoped).\\r\\n\\r\\n### Server Types\\r\\n\\r\\n| Type | Transport | Example |\\r\\n|------|-----------|---------|\\r\\n| **stdio** | Spawns a local process | `npx`, `python`, binary |\\r\\n| **http** | Connects to a remote URL | HTTP/SSE endpoint |\\r\\n\\r\\n### Example `.mcp.json`\\r\\n\\r\\n```json\\r\\n{\\r\\n  \\\"mcpServers\\\": {\\r\\n    \\\"context7\\\": {\\r\\n      \\\"command\\\": \\\"npx\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"args\\\": [\\\"-y\\\", \\\"@upstash/context7-mcp\\\"]\\r\\n    },\\r\\n    \\\"playwright\\\": {\\r\\n      \\\"command\\\": \\\"npx\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"args\\\": [\\\"-y\\\", \\\"@playwright/mcp\\\"]\\r\\n    },\\r\\n    \\\"deepwiki\\\": {\\r\\n      \\\"command\\\": \\\"npx\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"args\\\": [\\\"-y\\\", \\\"deepwiki-mcp\\\"]\\r\\n    },\\r\\n    \\\"remote-api\\\": {\\r\\n      \\\"type\\\": \\\"http\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"url\\\": \\\"https://mcp.example.com/mcp\\\"\\r\\n    }\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\nUse environment variable expansion for secrets instead of committing API keys in `.mcp.json`:\\r\\n\\r\\n```json\\r\\n{\\r\\n  \\\"mcpServers\\\": {\\r\\n    \\\"remote-api\\\": {\\r\\n      \\\"type\\\": \\\"http\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"url\\\": \\\"https://mcp.example.com/mcp?token=${MCP_API_TOKEN}\\\"\\r\\n    }\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n### Settings for MCP Servers\\r\\n\\r\\nThese settings in `.claude/settings.json` control MCP server approval:\\r\\n\\r\\n| Key | Type | Description |\\r\\n|-----|------|-------------|\\r\\n| `enableAllProjectMcpServers` | boolean | Auto-approve all `.mcp.json` servers without prompting |\\r\\n| `enabledMcpjsonServers` | array | Allowlist of specific server names to auto-approve |\\r\\n| `disabledMcpjsonServers` | array | Blocklist of specific server names to reject |\\r\\n\\r\\n### Permission Rules for MCP Tools\\r\\n\\r\\nMCP tools follow the `mcp__<server>__<tool>` naming convention in permission rules:\\r\\n\\r\\n```json\\r\\n{\\r\\n  \\\"permissions\\\": {\\r\\n    \\\"allow\\\": [\\r\\n      \\\"mcp__*\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"mcp__context7__*\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"mcp__playwright__browser_snapshot\\\"\\r\\n    ],\\r\\n    \\\"deny\\\": ccbp-claude-mcp-full\\n## Configuration\\r\\n\\r\\nMCP servers are configured in `.mcp.json` at the project root (project-scoped) or in `~/.claude.json` (user-scoped).\\r\\n\\r\\n### Server Types\\r\\n\\r\\n| Type | Transport | Example |\\r\\n|------|-----------|---------|\\r\\n| **stdio** | Spawns a local process | `npx`, `python`, binary |\\r\\n| **http** | Connects to a remote URL | HTTP/SSE endpoint |\\r\\n\\r\\n### Example `.mcp.json`\\r\\n\\r\\n```json\\r\\n{\\r\\n  \\\"mcpServers\\\": {\\r\\n    \\\"context7\\\": {\\r\\n      \\\"command\\\": \\\"npx\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"args\\\": [\\\"-y\\\", \\\"@upstash/context7-mcp\\\"]\\r\\n    },\\r\\n    \\\"playwright\\\": {\\r\\n      \\\"command\\\": \\\"npx\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"args\\\": [\\\"-y\\\", \\\"@playwright/mcp\\\"]\\r\\n    },\\r\\n    \\\"deepwiki\\\": {\\r\\n      \\\"command\\\": \\\"npx\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"args\\\": [\\\"-y\\\", \\\"deepwiki-mcp\\\"]\\r\\n    },\\r\\n    \\\"remote-api\\\": {\\r\\n      \\\"type\\\": \\\"http\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"url\\\": \\\"https://mcp.example.com/mcp\\\"\\r\\n    }\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\nUse environment variable expansion for secrets instead of committing API keys in `.mcp.json`:\\r\\n\\r\\n```json\\r\\n{\\r\\n  \\\"mcpServers\\\": {\\r\\n    \\\"remote-api\\\": {\\r\\n      \\\"type\\\": \\\"http\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"url\\\": \\\"https://mcp.example.com/mcp?token=${MCP_API_TOKEN}\\\"\\r\\n    }\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n### Settings for MCP Servers\\r\\n\\r\\nThese settings in `.claude/settings.json` control MCP server approval:\\r\\n\\r\\n| Key | Type | Description |\\r\\n|-----|------|-------------|\\r\\n| `enableAllProjectMcpServers` | boolean | Auto-approve all `.mcp.json` servers without prompting |\\r\\n| `enabledMcpjsonServers` | array | Allowlist of specific server names to auto-approve |\\r\\n| `disabledMcpjsonServers` | array | Blocklist of specific server names to reject |\\r\\n\\r\\n### Permission Rules for MCP Tools\\r\\n\\r\\nMCP tools follow the `mcp__<server>__<tool>` naming convention in permission rules:\\r\\n\\r\\n```json\\r\\n{\\r\\n  \\\"permissions\\\": {\\r\\n    \\\"allow\\\": [\\r\\n      \\\"mcp__*\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"mcp__context7__*\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"mcp__playwright__browser_snapshot\\\"\\r\\n    ],\\r\\n    \\\"deny\\\": [\\r\\n      \\\"mcp__dangerous-server__*\\\"\\r\\n    ]\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\n```\\n\\n### eee-mcp-json (2)\\n{\\n  \\\"_comment\\\": \\\"Wave 75 2026-05-08 — Tier-2A HTTP MCPs (github + context7 + Types\\r\\n\\r\\n| Type | Transport | Example |\\r\\n|------|-----------|---------|\\r\\n| **stdio** | Spawns a local process | `npx`, `python`, binary |\\r\\n| **http** | Connects to a remote URL | \\\"@playwright/mcp\\\"]\\r\\n    },\\r\\n    \\\"deepwiki\\\": {\\r\\n      \\\"command\\\": \\\"npx\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"args\\\": [\\\"-y\\\", \\\"deepwiki-mcp\\\"]\\r\\n    },\\r\\n    \\\"remote-api\\\": {\\r\\n      \\\"type\\\": \\\"http\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"url\\\": \\\"https://mcp.example.com/mcp\\\"\\r\\n    }\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\nUse environment variable expansion for secrets instead of committing API keys in `.mcp.json`:\\r\\n\\r\\n```json\\r\\n{\\r\\n  \\\"mcpServers\\\": {\\r\\n    \\\"remote-api\\\": {\\r\\n      \\\"type\\\": \\\"http\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"url\\\": \\\"https://mcp.example.com/mcp?token=${MCP_API_TOKEN}\\\"\\r\\n    }\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n### Settings for MCP Servers\\r\\n\\r\\nThese settings in `.claude/settings.json` control MCP server approval:\\r\\n\\r\\n| Key | Type | Description |\\r\\n|-----|------|-------------|\\r\\n| `enableAllProjectMcpServers` | boolean | Auto-approve all `.mcp.json` servers without prompting |\\r\\n| `enabledMcpjsonServers` | array | Allowlist of specific server names to auto-approve |\\r\\n| `disabledMcpjsonServers` | array | Blocklist of specific server names to reject |\\r\\n\\r\\n### Permission Rules for MCP Tools\\r\\n\\r\\nMCP tools follow the `mcp__<server>__<tool>` naming convention in permission rules:\\r\\n\\r\\n```json\\r\\n{\\r\\n  \\\"permissions\\\": {\\r\\n    \\\"allow\\\": [\\r\\n      \\\"mcp__*\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"mcp__context7__*\\\",\\r\\n      \\\"mcp__playwright__browser_snapshot\\\"\\r\\n    ],\\r\\n    \\\"deny\\\":
